hook: Paddy at *₹3,500–4,500*/quintal, and Murasu's rain hits harvest week
hook_b: Why rain this week could push your rice bill up
tldr: Telangana farmers fear Murasu's rain will damage paddy and cotton just as prices run high.

beats.what: Rain is forecast across Telangana Nov 2–4 with paddy at harvest, near harvest or pre-flowering.
beats.why: Cyclone Murasu is crossing the AP coast; six Telangana districts are on orange alert.
beats.care: Rice prices are already high in Hyderabad. Crop damage could tighten supply further.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Khammam, Mahabubnagar, Nalgonda, Suryapet, Nagarkurnool and Wanaparthy are forecast heavy to very heavy rain on Monday (The Hindu). Fresh paddy is fetching ₹3,500–4,500 a quintal, against about ₹2,900 (MSP plus ₹500 fine-rice bonus) earlier. Farmers say soaked, drooping panicles double harvester time; machines cost ₹2,500–3,000 an hour (Donthu Rambabu, Telangana Rythu Sangham). Wet grain loses weight when dried and discoloured grain fetches less. Cotton near harvest is also at risk. The Agriculture Department says it has alerted farmers and told officials to supply tarpaulin sheets. Damage figures are not known yet.
